svg.title: Sudoku solve rates across two training seeds
svg.desc: Measured aggregate solve rates from e20-seed-assessment.json. E19 seed 0: 98.10, 83.40, 40.30 percent. E20 seed 1: 97.25, 79.60, 33.25 percent. Dashed Original NCM references are not a matched-budget comparison.
